detail.overview: Intex 32-inch HD Smart TV Upgrade your entertainment setup with the Intex LED-SGQV3208, a 32-inch HD Smart TV powered by Google TV. With built-in Chromecast, Dolby Audio, voice-enabled remote, and a vibrant frameless HD display, this TV packs big features in a compact size. Enjoy seamless access to your favorite apps like Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more with 1.5 GB RAM + 8 GB ROM. Perfect for streaming, gaming, or binge-watching, this TV redefines smart viewing at an affordable price.
